_: The road-damage model the Scan road screen runs on the phone (DetectorConfig.kt).
Swapping the model is this file plus the .onnx beside it: name the new file in
model, list its classes in the model's index order (they are checked against the
ONNX metadata key names at load, and a mismatch is refused, never guessed), set
inputWidth/inputHeight to its imgsz, and quote its measured mAP50 from ai/README.md.
reportAs maps a model class to the hazard type POST /v1/raksha/report accepts;
a class not listed there is shown but cannot be reported (onnx_detector.INGESTABLE).
faded_marking and manhole are deliberately not listed, as on the web scan
(scan-core.js NOT_REPORTABLE): road_damage means cracking in this model's training
map, and RDD2022 D50 labels every manhole cover, closed ones included.
minConfidence and iouThreshold are ai/serve.py defaults (NMS IoU 0.7 = onnx_detector.NMS_IOU).
metricsSource: held-out yolo-multi-rich val, 800 images, measured 2026-10-08 (ai/runs/yolo11n-india-ft-gpu/compare.json, rich@416; India-clean 392 images: 0.449)
